articles.title: We Tested the Hottest E-Scooters: Here's Which One Rules the Road
articles.summary: Ditch the car for short trips—we put electric scooters through real city commutes. The Segway Ninebot Max impressed with a 40-mile range and self-healing tires. But a budget pick surprised us too.

articles.title: A Century-Old Medical Mystery: The Enigma of the 'Sleeping Sickness'
articles.summary: While the Spanish Flu ravaged the globe, a bizarre neurological disease turned thousands into living statues or restless insomniacs. Encephalitis lethargica killed 500,000, and its cause remains unknown.

articles.title: Shakira Shuts Down Fake Endorsements in Colombian Election
articles.summary: Manipulated images falsely showed Shakira backing Colombian presidential candidates. The singer issued a firm denial, emphasizing her neutrality and calling for transparent, peaceful elections.
